title: AI-driven memory crunch jolts India’s smartphone market
slides: India's smartphone boom just hit a hidden wall.
AI apps now need 8GB RAM for basic tasks.
Most budget phones still ship with 4GB or less.
Your next upgrade may not run the apps you need.
Check RAM specs before buying any phone today.
thread_text:
1. Your phone is already obsolete.

AI apps now demand 8GB RAM for basic tasks. Most budget phones ship with 4GB or less.

2. The spec you ignored.

That 4GB phone you bought last year? It’s already locked out of the next generation of apps.

3. India’s silent barrier.

Smartphone sales are booming. But AI requirements just turned millions of devices into paperweights.

4. The upgrade trap.

Your next phone might not run the apps you need. Check the RAM before you buy.

5. Check your RAM today.

Open your settings and look. Is it under 8GB? Your next app update may not install.
